publication_decision.why_not_main: The candidate history starts at 7c78457. Public main has not moved since PR 16 branched, so a PR against main would contain and land PR 16's three held commits. Stacking on codex/open-dv-track shows only the 22 nativehdr10 commits and keeps PR 16 held.
publication_decision.merge_dependency: The PR cannot merge independently of PR 16. Merging it into codex/open-dv-track would move PR 16's head; merging it into main would land PR 16. It is left open and reviewable until the owner releases PR 16, after which it can be rebased or merged in order.
publication_decision.mergeability_on_main: Dry merge-tree shows no conflict with current main; this is informational only.
publication_decision.pull_request: recorded in docs/STATUS.md and docs/HANDOFF.md after the PR is opened

verifier.method: Python 3 with -I; hashes every log named by the public evidence and by every ledger attempt against the extracted receipt-logs archive; no network, no execution of checks

decisions_recorded: Stack the PR on codex/open-dv-track rather than main, for the reason above; alternative of rebasing the 22 commits onto main was rejected because the series pins, docs and bundle require the 7c78457 handoff content and because it would present held work as new.
Open the PR as a draft so the merge button stays disabled while PR 16 is held; a draft is fully reviewable and the owner can mark it ready.
Run scripts/check_repository.py once on each delivery commit because documentation edits invalidate its link check; no other check is invalidated by documentation.
